reason: Revision E-20261002-02-r2 adds explicit call records for every call, whole-item failure handling with paired denominators, a 2% item-failure invalidation threshold, a tie rule and dry scorer outputs in the freeze bundle, answering REV-20261002-10 (whose target was the sibling spec E-20261001-03-r2). It still moves working beliefs B11 and B14 on the priority 1 question shape for staleness gates, and is cheap enough (under 5 USD) to run before more System One gates are built.
